WPSS No.2193 of 2022
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for 
the petitioners.
Mr. Narain Dutt, Standing 
Counsel for the State. 
None is present for the 
respondent nos.2 to 8.
Learned counsel for the 
petitioners would submit that they 
are entitled to pay parity.
When the Court wanted to 
know, as to whether this matter 
may be entertained by the State 
Public Services Tribunal (for short, 
“tribunal”)? Learned counsel for the 
petitioners would submit that it 
relates to the Board. Hence, it may 
not be entertained by the Tribunal. 
This Court keeps this question 
of jurisdiction open.
Heard.
Admit.
Learned State counsel seeks 
time to file counter affidavit.
It may be filed within four 
weeks.
Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, may be filed.
List for final hearing on 
07.11.2023. 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 15.06.2023
Sanjay
